answer: Pearson r ≈ 0.0617 (n = 19,942 protein-coding genes). Mean expression was computed as the arithmetic mean of the batch-corrected read counts as-is over the 151 annotation-defined CD4 samples (celltype == 'CD4'; the 135-name CD4-suffix heuristic was not used). Length is in base pairs and unit-invariant for Pearson correlation. The correlation is small and positive but statistically significant at this large n (p ≈ 2.8e-18): r ≈ 0.0617.
